scope: Four finite inequalities: harmonic-term cone floor, selected-edge product, actual cylinder multiplier bound, arbitrary-reference heavy-cell comparison. Three measure-theoretic deductions invoke first Borel-Cantelli to retain infinitely many good returns, select an increasing subsequence, and obtain arbitrarily small good real-ball mass bounds. The actual Collatz bad-event estimate, recurrence, canonical trace construction, clock tail, information dimension and full Collatz convergence are not formalized.
